title: Four-model synthetic performance across six outcome-horizon cells
population: Four reference models evaluated on three fixed roots from one public synthetic generator.
metric: Cellwise NRMSE: RMSE divided by that cell's population SD; three root values and the stored root mean are shown.
units: NRMSE dimensionless; mean concentric-force target N/kg and net-impulse target m/s remain separate cells.
grouping: Four reference models x three horizons x two outcomes x three fixed evaluation roots.
sample_sizes: Each root has 16 camps, 4,000 episodes, and 12,000 horizon rows; 4,000 rows per outcome-horizon cell.
uncertainty: No confidence interval; root points and their stored mean show descriptive variation across these three fixed same-generator roots.
caption_tex: Existing public fixed-mode synthetic benchmark across six outcome-horizon cells. Each panel shows, for the zero-innovation baseline, training-mean baseline, ridge regression and structured comparator, the three fixed evaluation roots (A circle, B square, C triangle; offset horizontally only to separate marks) and the stored mean (black bar, value printed). Rows are H24, H48 and H72; columns are mean concentric-force innovation (\si{\Nkg} target) and net-impulse innovation (\si{\mps} target). The force cells retain the legacy registered identifier \ident{relative_peak_mean_force_innovation}, but the target is mean, not peak, concentric force. The vertical axis is cellwise NRMSE (dimensionless) on a common scale; the dashed line marks NRMSE\,=\,1. Each root contains 16 camps and 4,000 rows per cell. Points and means describe three fixed same-generator roots, not confidence intervals or human cohorts.
